candidates.change_summary: Remove the super.supportsInterface call so only the IAccessControl interface id is supported.
Replace the checked interface id with IERC165 so IAccessControl's id is no longer reported as supported.
Replace the return expression with `return true;` so hasRole always returns true.
Replace the return expression with `return false;` so hasRole always returns false.
Return the negation of the membership flag.
Look up membership of address(0) instead of the given account.
Return the default admin role constant instead of the stored admin role.
Return the role itself instead of its stored admin role.
Remove the require that forces the caller to renounce only their own role, allowing any caller to renounce any account's role.
Invert the self-check so the call reverts exactly when the account IS the caller, blocking self-renounce while allowing renouncing others.
Grant the role instead of revoking it, so after a renounceRole call the account holds the role rather than losing it.
